name: From the life of a thief
storyline:
To join the "Society," arguably the largest criminal organization in the empire, our hero must prove himself worthy. After a long wait, he finally gets the chance and is now on a ship. His mission: to steal a gemstone. That's all he knows. When will he set sail? He doesn't know until he's suddenly dragged from his bunk in the early morning, hauled onto the deck, and thrown overboard.
With nothing but his underwear and a piece of paper, our hero drifts in the water. But in the distance, he sees land. After what feels like an eternity, he reaches it. Exhausted, he pulls himself up onto the wooden planks of an old pier. "The Society's terrifying reputation isn't there for nothing," the thought keeps swirling through our hero's mind.
His goal is clear. "I have to find that gemstone!" That's all he can think about. But where is it, and how is he supposed to find it?
Step into the shoes of our young thief and experience a thrilling tale of stealing his life. Meet believable characters, superbly voiced. Explore a new and diverse world on the edge of the empire.
Will you do anything to achieve your goal? Will you steal, kidnap, or even murder? Or will you perhaps realize that your path is wrong and choose a different path to help others?
summary:
You take on the role of a young man trained as a thief by a mysterious organization. To complete your training, you must pass a secret final exam on remote island. All you know is that you're supposed to blend in and steal something very valuable from a powerful man. Only with a great deal of patience, skill and tenacity can this mission be accomplished. A conscience could prove to be more of a hindrance than a help...

The mod offers typical Gothic gameplay, but spiced up with some stealth elements. Features:
- a completely new world
- approximately 12 hours of gameplay
- new weapons, armor, monsters...
- new script features (changing loading screens, fishing, different arrow types...)
- many innovative quests with sometimes different ways to solve them... and the resulting consequences
- NPCs are real personalities and each has their own character
- the exceptionally high-quality german voice acting creates a captivating atmosphere
